## Change

What family or glyph changed, and why?

## Evidence and proof

Link the historical source and rights basis, or explain how this refinement fits
the recorded sources. Include a specimen or before/after PDF and sample text.

## Checks

- [ ] Source, generated files, and family changelog are included.
- [ ] Existing families have a version bump for font changes.
- [ ] `python scripts/fontrevival.py check` passes.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes.
- [ ] I inspected the proofs and relevant character combinations.
- [ ] My original contributions are offered under MIT; reference rights are recorded.
